title: Enum Constraints and Valid Values
query: Set the log level to verbose mode

level.description: Log level (from least to most verbose)

explanation: The schema uses an ENUM constraint - only specific values are allowed. The user wants 'verbose mode' but 'verbose' is not in the enum. Reading the description and enum values: error < warn < info < debug < trace (least to most verbose). 'trace' is the most verbose level, matching user intent. Key lesson: map user's natural language to schema's constrained values.
learning_points: Enum constraints limit parameter to specific allowed values
Must map natural language query to exact enum value
'verbose' means most detailed, which is 'trace' here
Read enum descriptions to understand the semantic meaning
Never use values not in the enum, even if they seem logical
